questions.question: Analyse toxic relationship affect an individual sense of self-worth and confidence? Explain. / [CO3]
questions.solution_html:
• A toxic relationship damages an individual’s self-worth through constant
  • criticism, control, and emotional neglect. It creates insecurity, fear, and
  • reduced confidence. Over time, the person may internalize negativity and
  • lose emotional stability.
